blocks.text: A Nigerian's Guide to UK, US & Beyond

blocks.html:
FACTS!
From 2018 to 2024, Revenue of Nigerians working Remote Jobs in UK, USA, and Canada has grown over 5000%. From over $100,000 to over $5million.

Now, there are more than 200,000 Nigerians working remote jobs in USA, UK, and Canada from Nigeria.


Why do some US, Uk, and Canadian companies prefer to hire Nigerians

  • Cost Efficiency
  • Strong English Language Skills
  • Educational Background
  • Growth In Professionalism in Nigeria
  • Nigerians are very Hardworking
